rustxng-index

Build and query a local index.

Run rustxng-index crawl to collect pages, then query them offline.

Table 1: Flags
FlagMeaning
--dry-runReport the plan without writing
--workersConcurrent fetchers

Without --dry-run the files are left untouched only after a successful run[1].

cargo run --release --example local_quality -- index-docs bench/quality-questions-100.json
  1. The index writer commits at the end of the run.
